 See what the stars have in store for your sign By Snehaa Khanna Sahgal 30 October 2026 Illustration by: Saahir Shetty ( @saahir_shetty ) From being black and white about something, you are now in the zone of accepting and noticing the greys. Libra , and you are doing this non-judgementally. You are pushing through, but needing rest. You feel like you are the only person pushing against the grain, and you can't go on with it for much longer. So rest. Take on a broader perspective and figure out the underlying structure. Things will fall in place shortly after.
 Cosmic tip: Choose your peace by interrupting the unconscious choice to go against the current.
